name: Field Museum — Main Level

coordinates.bounds: minimum inclusive, maximum exclusive; reject out-of-range indices

encoding: rows of single-character cell codes; cells[row][column]

navigation.clearancePolicy: free cells whose centre is closer than 1 m to any obstacle surface (walls, columns, display cases, exhibits), a closed room or the outside are clearance_buffer (4); every walkable cell centre is at least that far away
navigation.componentPolicy: largest connected component only; other free cells code 5

source.limitation: Procedural reconstruction; walls, doors and furniture approximate reality.
